newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Resources to buy Highlands.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Resources to buy Highlands.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said on Friday that it had agreed to buy Highlands Gas Corp, including debt and other obligations, for roughly $180 million.
Highlands is a privately owned natural gas gathering and processing company with assets in the Permian Basin of West Texas and southeastern New Mexico.
"The Highlands acquisition fits with UPR's stated strategies of growing its gathering, processing and marketing business near existing core areas," said UPR's chief executive Jack Messman.
Union Pacific Resources Group Inc is an oil and gas exploration and production company.
